<module id="float_multi">
    <description>Multiplies two 32-bit IEEE 754 floating point numbers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset.</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NAN">32'h7FC00000</parameter>
        <parameter id="INF">32'h7F800000</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="counter" type="reg" width="3">Cycle counter.</signal>
        <signal id="a_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input 'a'.</signal>
        <signal id="b_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input 'b'.</signal>
        <signal id="z_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of output 'z'.</signal>
        <signal id="a_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input 'a'.</signal>
        <signal id="b_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input 'b'.</signal>
        <signal id="z_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of output 'z'.</signal>
        <signal id="a_sign" type="reg">Sign of input 'a'.</signal>
        <signal id="b_sign" type="reg">Sign of input 'b'.</signal>
        <signal id="z_sign" type="reg">Sign of output 'z'.</signal>
        <signal id="product" type="reg" width="50">Product of mantissas.</signal>
        <signal id="guard_bit" type="reg">Guard bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="round_bit" type="reg">Round bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="sticky" type="reg">Sticky bit for rounding.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize counter
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                case(counter)
                    3'd0: begin
                        // Extract mantissas, exponents, and sign bits
                        a_mantissa <= {1'b1, a[22:0]};
                        b_mantissa <= {1'b1, b[22:0]};
                        a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                        b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                        a_sign <= a[31];
                        b_sign <= b[31];
                        counter <= 3'd1;
                    end
                    
                    3'd1: begin
                        // Handle special cases
                        if ((a == NAN || b == NAN)) begin
                            z <= NAN;
                            counter <= 3'd2;
                        end else if ((a == INF && b != 0) || (b == INF && a != 0)) begin
                            z <= INF;
                            counter <= 3'd2;
                        end else if (a == 0 || b == 0) begin
                            z <= 0;
                            counter <= 3'd2;
                        end else begin
                            // Normalize mantissas if necessary
                            if (a_exponent == 0) begin
                                a_mantissa <= {1'b0, a[22:0]};
                                a_exponent <= 10'd1;
                            end
                            if (b_exponent == 0) begin
                                b_mantissa <= {1'b0, b[22:0]};
                                b_exponent <= 10'd1;
                            end
                            counter <= 3'd2;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    3'd2: begin
                        // Multiply mantissas
                        product <= a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
                        z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 10'd127;
                        z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                        counter <= 3'd3;
                    end
                    
                    3'd3: begin
                        // Round and normalize the result
                        guard_bit <= product[23];
                        round_bit <= product[22];
                        sticky <= |product[21:0];
                        
                        if (product[49]) begin
                            z_mantissa <= product[48:24] >> 1;
                            z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
                        end else begin
                            z_mantissa <= product[47:23];
                        end
                        
                        if (z_exponent >= 10'd255) begin
                            z <= {z_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0};
                        end else if (z_exponent <= 0) begin
                            z <= {z_sign, 8'h0, 23'h0};
                        end else begin
                            z <= {z_sign, z_exponent[7:0], z_mantissa[22:0]};
                        end
                        counter <= 3'd4;
                    end
                    
                    default: begin
                        counter <= 3'd0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
